summary: Well-structured test suite across three layers (unit tests in VersionBumper.Tests.ps1, workflow validation in Workflow.Tests.ps1, and end-to-end integration via act in ActPipeline.Tests.ps1). All 28 unit tests are accounted for and cover core functionality (version bumping logic, file format handling, changelog generation) plus error scenarios. The workflow tests validate YAML structure, actionlint compliance, job dependencies, and script references. The act pipeline tests exercise three concrete bump scenarios (feat→minor, fix→patch, breaking→major) with exact output assertions. Strengths: good separation of concerns, proper test isolation (temp directories, cleanup), clear naming, error-case coverage, real-world CI validation. Limitations: test code references fixture files and VersionBumper.psm1 implementation that aren't shown, preventing full verification; fragile regex assertion on "Tests Passed: 28" output; act pipeline tests only happy paths, no negative scenarios; missing documentation of .actrc and fixture file formats; some assumptions about pre-installed container dependencies (actionlint, Pester).
